setVerifyD.message: Check that the proxy works with network requests right after connecting. Without this setting the proxy is connected even if it is down: the failure shows up later — from the connection errors the browser returns on real requests.

setSiteRowT.message: Rule for the current site in the extension window

setSiteRowD.message: The “Proxy for:” row in the window turns proxying on and off for the active tab’s site with one switch. The switch adds the site to the active list (black or white) or removes it from there, and also acts on the page’s third-party addresses (from request monitoring); while the lists are off the switch is locked. A rule is the same as adding the domain by hand and applies in every tab. The page’s subdomains and third-party hosts one by one are in the panel behind the site plate.

setSiteTrackD.message: The background records the hosts the tab contacted and failed requests — a browser error code or a 5xx response. The window shows the count of hosts without errors; the panel shows failure reasons and the request route: via proxy or direct. Data is kept in the browser’s temporary memory until it closes, erased when monitoring is turned off, and never sent anywhere. The requests of an address can be viewed via the “N requests” tag in the address panel.
setSiteTrackD.description: 7Е: the wording “in the browser’s temporary memory” instead of jargon (same meaning — the temporary storage area lives until the browser closes); the rest — 7Ж/7Л as it was

While the switch is off (the default), the shortcuts do nothing. You can change them on the browser’s shortcuts page — its address is shown below; clicking it copies the address.

setAutoUpdateT.message: Refresh the list from your account

diagRemoteGot.description: 7И: value of diagRemote when there is a cache: $1 — number of messages in the cache (all languages), $2 — link domain from the file (site; default host when absent), $3 — date of the last successful fetch in the browser locale

diagMigrateFail.message: previous-version data found, migration not done
